_note: Authored input for scripts/build-card-bible.ts. Everything else in lib/card-bible.json is merged from Cass's data files; these lines are written to the brand voice (~/cardblueprints-ops/plans/brand-voice-2026-09-13.md): second person, present tense, tendencies not predictions, one concrete thing to watch for in the next few weeks, no em dashes.

watchFor.ace-of-hearts: Watch the ten seconds after you say it first. Notice whether you let the silence breathe or fill it with three more texts.
watchFor.2-of-hearts: Watch how fast you know what they want for dinner. Then try to remember the last thing you wanted.
watchFor.3-of-hearts: Watch the first boring week of anything new. Notice the flaw that suddenly appears in your head on day eight.
watchFor.4-of-hearts: Watch what you do when someone brings you a feeling at dinner. Notice if you reach for a solution or a calendar before you look at them.
watchFor.5-of-hearts: Watch the plans you make the day after someone asks you to stay. Notice how far away they are.
watchFor.6-of-hearts: Watch the yes that comes out while your stomach is saying no. Notice who hears the full story later.
watchFor.7-of-hearts: Watch the talk where you give an analysis instead of an answer. Notice whether you felt anything or only described it.
watchFor.8-of-hearts: Watch yourself explain to someone how they should react to what you did. Notice how fast the explanation arrived.
watchFor.9-of-hearts: Watch the week your calendar fills with other people's emergencies. Notice there is no slot with your name on it.
watchFor.10-of-hearts: Watch the group chat where you check everyone's mood before you type what you want. Notice how often you delete it.
watchFor.jack-of-hearts: Watch how much backstory you write for someone you met twice. Notice whether you have seen them on a boring Wednesday.
watchFor.queen-of-hearts: Watch the help nobody asked for. Notice what you expect back by Friday.
watchFor.king-of-hearts: Watch the room that agrees with you a little too fast. Notice what stayed unsaid.
watchFor.ace-of-clubs: Watch how fast you go from having an idea to defending it like a custody case.
watchFor.2-of-clubs: Watch the argument where the last word starts to matter more than the right one.
watchFor.3-of-clubs: Watch Friday's list. Many starts, and only the easy one crossed off.
watchFor.4-of-clubs: Watch your face when someone shows you a newer number than the one your system runs on.
watchFor.5-of-clubs: Watch for the debate you give CPR after everyone signed off on the plan.
watchFor.6-of-clubs: Watch for the explanation nobody requested. Notice who wanted it, which is usually no one.
watchFor.7-of-clubs: Watch the project entering its third week of research. Ship the ugly version before the research becomes a lifestyle.
watchFor.8-of-clubs: Watch who goes quiet after you make your point. Quiet is not agreement. Sometimes it is surrender.
watchFor.9-of-clubs: Watch for the moment you treat someone's opinion like an early version of yours. It is a different document.
watchFor.10-of-clubs: Watch which fact you keep pocketed so nobody else can answer. Give it away.
watchFor.jack-of-clubs: Watch for the idea you announce before you have tried to build it. Notice how good it sounded.
watchFor.queen-of-clubs: Watch the second you decide someone cannot handle what you know. Ask who that protects.
watchFor.king-of-clubs: Watch how fast the room agrees with you lately. Then notice who used to argue and has gone quiet.
watchFor.ace-of-diamonds: Watch the purchase you bring up twice in one week. It is doing a job.
watchFor.2-of-diamonds: Watch the check you grab so you get to run the split.
watchFor.3-of-diamonds: Watch the night you buy a domain for a new idea while last month's idea still has no customers.
watchFor.4-of-diamonds: Watch the purchase that obviously pays for itself and has lived in your cart since spring.
watchFor.5-of-diamonds: Watch what you buy on a gray, nothing Wednesday. Listen to the story you tell the receipt.
watchFor.6-of-diamonds: Watch the favor you do with a quiet asterisk, and the month you bring it back up at dinner.
watchFor.7-of-diamonds: Watch the month the account is fine and your stomach files a complaint anyway.
watchFor.8-of-diamonds: Watch the moment you drop a dollar amount into an argument with someone you love, just to make it stop.
watchFor.9-of-diamonds: Watch the present you buy while exhausted, then mark your calendar. The resentment usually lands in two weeks.
watchFor.10-of-diamonds: Watch the week you celebrate the result and forget to thank the person who carried half of it.
watchFor.jack-of-diamonds: Watch the deadline you announce for a product with no prototype.
watchFor.queen-of-diamonds: Watch when closeness starts costing something: a loan you mention later, a gift with a mood, a favor with terms.
watchFor.king-of-diamonds: Watch the week someone's work lifts your standing and their name never comes up in the meeting.
watchFor.ace-of-spades: Watch your timing on the honest sentence. Notice whether you saved it for the moment it would hurt most.
watchFor.2-of-spades: Watch the decision you keep leaving open. See who ends up making it, and how relieved that makes you.
watchFor.3-of-spades: Watch for the moment your rough week becomes proof the other person is wrong. Clock how many seconds it takes.
watchFor.4-of-spades: Watch how fast you say no to a new thing. Did you even open the invite?
watchFor.5-of-spades: Watch the peaceful week. Catch the moment you poke it, and the story you tell about why.
watchFor.6-of-spades: Watch the friend you keep texting about their crisis. Notice the slump when they stop needing you.
watchFor.7-of-spades: Watch the good news this week. Time how long you hunt for the fine print.
watchFor.8-of-spades: Watch the argument you win this week. Count the days until anyone on that team brings you bad news again.
watchFor.9-of-spades: Watch for the door you slam early this month. Check what was still half-built behind it.
watchFor.10-of-spades: Watch someone finally hit your target. Clock how fast you move it.
watchFor.jack-of-spades: Watch the hard sentence you save for the doorway, coat already on.
watchFor.queen-of-spades: Watch the fact you keep in your pocket during a meeting. Notice what keeping it gets you.
watchFor.king-of-spades: Watch for a week of hard calls you make in silence. Notice that nobody knows what any of them cost you.

joker.name: The Joker
joker.title: The One Outside the Map
joker.coreIdentity: You were born on December 31, the one birthday the 52 card map skips. Your day holds the Joker, the card that sits outside the deck and can stand in for any of them. You read a room fast and take the job it is missing. People meet several versions of you, and every one of them is real.
joker.sweetSpot: You sit outside on purpose. You pick up the job nobody grabbed, say what the people with assigned seats cannot, and leave once the room can run itself.
joker.shadow: Being the exception turns into a permanent excuse. Nothing lands, and every role goes back to the rental shop by Friday.
joker.cost: You never stay at one address, so eventually people stop knocking for whoever lives under all those costumes.
joker.watchFor: Watch the week you give three different bios to three different people. Notice which one you would keep if you could only have one.
